records.name: Intercambiador Santa Catalina
records.location: Intercambiador de Santa Catalina, Parque de Santa Catalina / port district, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
records.description: The city bus interchange beside Santa Catalina Park is a genuine operating transit facility. Gays-Cruising's Las Palmas index labels the interchange as a cruising candidate, but supplies neither a named toilet nor a verifiable recent encounter. The broader Santa Catalina Park has a documented queer meeting history: Canary Islands government research mentions former public urinals, now a police premises, as historic encounter space. This historical fact must not be transferred to today's bus interchange.
